project.name: BalanceKube
project.description: Automated Kubernetes cost-optimisation and workload placement platform. Connects to customer AWS accounts, deploys in-cluster agents, classifies workloads, generates Spot placement recommendations, detects drift, and executes approved node migrations with full rollback capability.
project.architecture: Monorepo — Backend (Node.js/TypeScript) · Frontend (React/TypeScript) · Workers (BullMQ) · Agent (Go) · Infrastructure (Terraform/Helm) · Shared Libraries

Terraform state in S3 with DynamoDB locking table
ACM certificate DNS-validated via Route53
IAM roles follow least-privilege: backend API role, worker role, execution worker role
enable_deletion_protection=false (dev), true (prod)
All resources tagged: {Project=balancekube, ManagedBy=terraform, Environment}
